def transform(grid):
    g=[row[:] for row in grid]
    bg=g[0][0]
    colors={v for row in g for v in row if v!=bg}
    color=max(colors, key=lambda v: sum(row.count(v) for row in g))
    h,w=len(g),len(g[0])
    changes=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            if g[r][c]==bg and ((c>0 and c+1<w and g[r][c-1]==color==g[r][c+1]) or (r>0 and r+1<h and g[r-1][c]==color==g[r+1][c])):
                changes.append((r,c))
    for r,c in changes:g[r][c]=2
    return g

    for c in range(w):
        positions=[r for r in range(h) if grid[r][c]==color]
        for a,b in zip(positions,positions[1:]):
            for r in range(a+1,b):
                if grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=2
    return out
